claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: restrained
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Web's core effect applies the Restrained condition. The Condition type currently only contains 'prone'. 'restrained' must be added to Condition before any save_gate rider for Web can be authored.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Restrained condition while in the webs or until it breaks free

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation: area_save_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Web's operation is: each time a creature enters the area or starts its turn there, open a save gate → on failure apply a condition. Neither 'roll_modifier' nor 'damage_on_hit' can express this. A new OngoingOperation variant is needed — something like { kind: 'area_save_gate'; trigger: 'enter_or_turn_start'; ability: Ability; dc: DcSource; onFail: ...; onSuccess: ... }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Restrained condition

claude_proposed_widenings.name: AreaEventTrigger: enter_or_turn_start
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The save gate on Web fires on two distinct events: (a) creature enters the area for the first time on a turn, (b) creature starts its turn in the area. This is a recurring trigger tied to creature movement/turn-cycling within the area, distinct from the one-shot 'enters_area' event used by anchored_trigger. A closed enum of area-event triggers is needed to express the 'first-entry-or-turn-start' pattern.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there

claude_proposed_widenings.name: AreaOperation: escape_check
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: A creature Restrained by the webs can take an Action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against the caster's spell save DC to break free. This is an ability-check escape from a condition — no current surface type models 'condition escape via ability check'. Needs a new operation or rider shape: { kind: 'escape_check'; ability: Ability; skill?: string; dc: DcSource; removes: Condition }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature Restrained by the webs can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer Restrained.
